title: WHIRLPOOL CORP /DE/ 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Whirlpool Corporation filed a Form 8-K reporting results from its 2026 Annual Meeting held April 21, 2026. The filing contains stockholder voting results including election of 12 directors, an advisory say-on-pay vote approving executive compensation, and ratification of Ernst & Young LLP as the company's independent auditor for 2026.
key_points: All 12 director nominees were elected to one-year terms expiring in 2027
Say-on-pay advisory vote approved with approximately 67% of votes cast in favor (26.8M for, 11.5M against, 333K abstain)
Ernst & Young LLP ratified as independent auditor with 97.3% of votes in favor (46.6M for, 1.07M against)
Broker non-votes totaled 10.2M for director elections and say-on-pay vote
Filing signed by Bridget K. Quinn, Deputy General Counsel & Corporate Secretary on April 24, 2026
